## Phase B — *new* preregistered scientific advance (NOT pooled with Phase A)
Study 3-state mass-conserving light-gate differential/discrete model with source-derived structure:
  dC/dt = gamma R - alpha(L) C
  dO/dt = alpha(L) C - beta O
  dR/dt = beta O - gamma R
  C + O + R = 1
  I_proxy(t) = g_bar * O(t) * (V(t)-E_rev)   [proxy only if assumed conductance/voltage parameters are declared]
with alpha(0)=0, beta,gamma>=0 and photon/light-to-rate relation explicitly identified as a choice. Unit tests should confirm nonnegativity and conserved mass; discretization may require positivity-preserving update/small-step control. Measure onset, light-off relaxation, pulse-pair recovery and desensitization. Do NOT claim synthetic rates fit real ChR2. A four-state branch C1/O1/O2/C2 is an independently preregistered challenger since published work indicates three states may fail to match continuous-illumination adaptation quantitatively.

Primary scientific references:
- https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC3388516/ (three-state photocycle coupled to current model)
- https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/j.1751-1097.2008.00460.x (three/four state ChR2 discussion)
- https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8204341/ (branched four-state continuous-illumination kinetics)
- https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC1366958/ (observed photocurrents and kinetic cycling)
- https://www.nsf.gov/bio/updates/nsf-bio-congratulates-winners-2026-nobel-prize-physiology-or (2026 Nobel context, not a fitted-data source)

Precommit TWO distinct new test sets: B1 common source/pulse and rates, with shared identical outputs; B2 seat-specific adversarial/method tests, report separately. Freeze definitions BEFORE writing producing program or seeing outcome. Source input, output encoding, step size/rounding, initial state, rate units, null cases, faults (injection stage, persistence, available ground truth) and exact comparisons all specified before run.
